payload.title: Optional backend features default to off, and synth fails when one lacks its prerequisites
payload.description: From Humorus HUM-4bca14. PAPYRUS_ENABLE_CONSOLE_RESPONDER defaulted to ON when unset, pulling in a container image the package does not build (ECR ImageNotFoundException at asset publish). Slack, inbound email and storage backups are the same kind of opt-in feature. Ryan 2026-11-12: no workarounds, no fallbacks; change the default itself and make papyrus-infra synth fail clearly (naming the flag and what is missing). The scaffold (PPY-f30ad5) writes the four flags explicitly.
